sloka: एषाम् वध अर्थम् शत्रूणाम् रक्षसाम् पाप कर्मणाम् ।तत् इदम् नः कृतम् कार्यम् त्वया दशरथ आत्मज ॥३-३०-३६॥
transliteration: eṣām vadha artham śatrūṇām rakṣasām pāpa karmaṇām ।tat idam naḥ kṛtam kāryam tvayā daśaratha ātmaja ॥3-30-36॥

translations.english: 'Rama who knows the self has performed a great work. Oh what prowess what efficiency only lord Visnu could do this'. So saying all the gods went back to their respective destinations.
